name: 3413-varlen-8bmlplora-1gpu
model: NousResearch/Meta-Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct, bf16, ~16.1 GB on one card. The ungated mirror of `meta-llama/Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct` -- same weights, and the `base_model_name_or_path` the served adapter declares in its own adapter_config.json; the Llama 3.1 Community License applies.
parallelism: TP=1, PP=1, DP=1, EP=1. One GPU, one server, no router and no external cache tier.
architecture: LlamaForCausalLM, 32 layers, GQA with 32 query heads over 8 KV heads (head_dim 128), hidden 4096, intermediate 14336, vocab 128256, RoPE scaled to 131072 positions; two adapter slots both holding `reissbaker/llama-3.1-8b-abliterated-lora`, r=64, lora_alpha=16, dropout 0, target_modules q/k/v/o/gate/up/down_proj.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), 32 streams, bounded at 600 requests, warmup 30%, seed 42. The server admits 8 at a time (`max-running-requests`), so most of the loop is queued at any moment.
workload: guidellm synthetic_text, single turn, over /v1/completions -- the raw completion route, because a chat template would prepend a fixed preamble and make the drawn prompt length not the served prompt length. Prompts mean 512 stdev 296 clamped to [8, 1024]; outputs mean 64 stdev 37 clamped to [8, 128]. Every request carries `lora_path: lora0` in its body, and output length is pinned by the `ignore_eos` guidellm sends beside max_tokens.
purpose: An uncensored-style 8B chat assistant served via a LoRA adapter on one H100 under 32 concurrent single-turn requests.
launch:
# Flat `key: value` only -- an indented or nested block is skipped by the reader, and the engine
# would then start without something this file declares.

model-path: NousResearch/Meta-Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct
tp-size: 1
lora-paths: ["lora0=reissbaker/llama-3.1-8b-abliterated-lora", "lora1=reissbaker/llama-3.1-8b-abliterated-lora"]
max-loras-per-batch: 2
max-running-requests: 8
disable-radix-cache: true
disable-cuda-graph: true
random-seed: 42

error.text: the declared workload needs a capability the PR itself adds, which the version before the PR lacks
